fixed_geometry.initialization_rule: cell-centre drawbox sampling of the declared box; native rho*dp^3 mass

registered_window.extension_policy: one whole-scope doubling after a frozen event right-censor

normalization.center_of_mass: active native mass weighted, divided by fixed tank dimensions
normalization.kinetic_energy: active kinetic energy divided by frame-zero native initial gravitational potential energy
normalization.obstacle_clearance: signed nearest distance to finite obstacle, divided by tank length
normalization.channel_fractions: fixed initial-native-mass denominator; front/back/rejoin regions use obstacle geometry
normalization.time: linear interpolation on the common registered output grid; no point-index comparison

geometry.front_channel: downstream x and y < obstacle ymin - 2dp
geometry.back_channel: downstream x and y > obstacle ymax + 2dp
geometry.rejoin: downstream x >= obstacle xmax + 4dp and lateral centroid within 0.125 tank widths of centerline

observer.qualification_use: geometry-aware diagnostic and numerical consistency comparison; no external physical truth claim

temporal_time_control.actual_evidence: solver/Run.csv Steps and PhysicalTime, not config CFL alone

canary_dependency.required_status: succeeded with hard_integrity_pass, mass gate, and complete event window
